answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 65917 Country: India Title: Is it permitted in Islam to make sculptures? Question: Is it permitted in Islam to make sculptures? Answer ID: 65917 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 675/549/D=08/1437) It is not lawful to make sculptures in Islam, it is severe sin. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
